description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BurgerSeller"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuQuestion" name="Menu or burger question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SidesQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SidesChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Enthusiastic status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order"
                      name="Order"
                      sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendOrder"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion"
                      name="Menu or burger question"
                      sourceRef="Task_RobotAskMenu"
                      targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveMenuQuestion"
                      messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuChoice"
                      name="Menu choice"
                      sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendMenuChoice"
                      targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveMenuChoice"
                      messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BurgerChoice"
                      name="Just-burger choice"
                      sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendBurgerChoice"
                      targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveMenuChoice"
                      messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SidesQuestion"
                      name="Fries or wedges question"
                      sourceRef="Task_RobotAskSides"
                      targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveSidesQuestion"
                      messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriesChoice"
                      name="Fries choice"
                      sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendFriesChoice"
                      targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveSidesChoice"
                      messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_WedgesChoice"
                      name="Wedges choice"
                      sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendWedgesChoice"
                      targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveSidesChoice"
                      messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderDelivered"
                      name="Order delivered"
                      sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder"
                      targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder"
                      messageRef="Message_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate"
                      name="Enthusiastic status update"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer orders and receives a burger" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CustomerSendOrder" name="Send order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CustomerReceiveMenuQuestion" name="Receive menu or burger question" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomerChooseMenu" name="Choose menu or just burger"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CustomerSendMenuChoice" name="Send menu choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CustomerSendBurgerChoice" name="Send just-burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CustomerReceiveSidesQuestion" name="Receive fries or wedges question" messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomerChooseSides" name="Choose fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerSidesChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CustomerSendFriesChoice" name="Send fries choice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CustomerSendWedgesChoice" name="Send wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder" name="Receive delivered order" messageRef="Message_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerReceivesOrder" name="Order received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Order" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_CustomerSendOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Order_MenuQuestion" sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendOrder" targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveMenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_MenuQuestion_Choose" sourceRef="Task_CustomerReceiveMenuQuestion" targetRef="Task_CustomerChooseMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Choose_MenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_CustomerChooseMenu" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_MenuChoice" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerSendMenuChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsMenu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_BurgerChoice" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerSendBurgerChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsJustBurger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_MenuChoice_SidesQuestion" sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveSidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_SidesQuestion_Choose" sourceRef="Task_CustomerReceiveSidesQuestion" targetRef="Task_CustomerChooseSides"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ChooseSides_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CustomerChooseSides" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerSidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_FriesChoice" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSidesChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerSendFriesChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsFries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_WedgesChoice" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerSidesChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerSendWedgesChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsWedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Fries_Order" sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendFriesChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Wedges_Order" sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendWedgesChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_BurgerChoice_Order" sourceRef="Task_CustomerSendBurgerChoice" targetRef="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Order_End" sourceRef="Task_CustomerReceiveOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerReceivesOrder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RobotAskMenu" name="Ask menu or just burger" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_RobotReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu or burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" name="Prepare menu components in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RobotAskSides" name="Ask fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_RobotReceiveSidesChoice" name="Receive fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SidesChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the fries order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SidesMerge" name="Join side preparation alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" name="Menu components ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Status">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdate" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Order_AskMenu" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_RobotAskMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_AskMenu_ReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_RobotAskMenu" targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_ReceiveChoice_MenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_RobotReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_MenuChoice_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsMenu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_MenuChoice_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsJustBurger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_MenuSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_MenuSplit_AskSides" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RobotAskSides"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Drink_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_AskSides_ReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_RobotAskSides" targetRef="Task_RobotReceiveSidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_ReceiveSides_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_RobotReceiveSidesChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_SidesChoice_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsFries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_SidesChoice_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsWedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Fries_SidesMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SidesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Wedges_SidesMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SidesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_SidesMerge_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_MenuJoin_BurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_BurgerMerge_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Prepare_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Deliver_End" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Timer_Status" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Robot_Status_End" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
